name: Question 3
problem:
The acceleration $a$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
a(t)=⟨\frac{1}{t+1},4⟩,\,t\in [0,\infty ).
$$

Given that the particle has velocity $v=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡10,3⟩$ when $t=1,$ calculate the velocity vector of $P$ at time $t.$

Question 3
?

The acceleration a at time t of a particle P moving in the xy-plane is given by a(t)=⟨1t+1,4⟩,t∈[0,∞). Given that the particle has velocity v=⟨ln⁡10,3⟩ when t=1, calculate the velocity vector of P at time t.

a
v=⟨ln⁡(5t+5),2t+1⟩
b
v=⟨ln⁡(2t+8),t+2⟩
c
v=⟨ln⁡(5t+5),4t−1⟩
d
v=⟨ln⁡(t+1)ln⁡10ln⁡2,4t−1⟩
e
v=⟨ln⁡(t+1)ln⁡10ln⁡2,2t+1⟩
Submit
